item: source article counters catch up at each pass end; field data source rows carry feed_key
summary: Field test 2026-11-14 row 75. Source.article_count was only ever set by the idle-window reconcile, which a continuously collecting machine never gets (collect_pass_owns_lock), so sources read low by what they collected since (es.wikipedia.org 514 vs 524, stamped 4.5 h before the export). catch_up_source_counters recounts at each pass end only the sources with an article above a watermark (derived_meta source_counter_article_watermark, set by the whole-corpus reconcile; a store without one starts from its oldest counter stamp; a never-counted store stays on the live count). No startup rewrite. Deletions below the watermark wait for the idle reconcile. The source-samples manifest and source-quality per-source rows carry feed_key beside domain (ids above the shipped catalogue differ across instances, report 5.4).
